scripts.text:
[Crewman]
Hey, have you heard of a place called Brasilis?
It's a tropical city that's hot like the desert but also rainy. It is a very mysterious place.
scripts.translation:
[船员]
嘿，你听说过一个叫巴西的地方吗？
那是一座热带城市，像沙漠一样炎热，但又经常下雨。那是一个充满神秘色彩的地方。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
We recently found a new ocean route to get there easily.
It's just 10,000 zeny for a round trip, and 1,000 for VIP! So do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[船员]
我们最近发现了一条新的海上航线，可以轻松到达那里。
往返只需10,000泽尼，VIP只要1,000！你想去吗？

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
We recently found a new ocean route to get there easily.
It's just 10,000 zeny for a round trip! So do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[船员]
我们最近发现了一条新的海上航线，可以轻松到达那里。
往返只需10,000泽尼！你想去吗？

scripts.text: Take me to Brasilis!
scripts.translation: 带我去巴西！

scripts.text: I'll stay here.
scripts.translation: 我留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
I said {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[船员]
我说的是{0}泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
Cool~!! Let's go~!
scripts.translation:
[船员]
太棒了~！！出发吧~！

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
Well if you're ever interested, let me know and I can take you there.
scripts.translation:
[船员]
好吧，如果你有兴趣，告诉我，我可以带你去那里。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
My ship is going to back to Alberta, do you want to join us?
scripts.translation:
[船员]
我的船要回艾尔贝塔了，你想加入我们吗？

scripts.text: Go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: Not yet~.
scripts.translation: 先不去了~。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
I sure do miss home.
scripts.translation:
[船员]
我真想念家乡啊。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
Ok, suit yourself. We'll see you when we get back then.
scripts.translation:
[船员]
好吧，随你便。那我们回来时再见。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Come~come~
Ice cream is the perfect snack for a hot day~
It's just ^3355FF100 Zeny^000000~
Ice Cream~
Get 'yer Ice Cream!
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
来呀~来呀~
冰淇淋是炎热天气里的完美零食~
只要^3355FF100泽尼^000000~
冰淇淋~
快来买冰淇淋！

scripts.text: Give me one!
scripts.translation: 给我一个！

scripts.text: Ice Cream?
scripts.translation: 冰淇淋？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Since there are so many people want to get a cool ice cream you can order only 5 at a time.
So how many d'ya want?
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
因为想买到清凉冰淇淋的人太多了，你一次只能订购5个。
所以你想要几个？

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
None?
Fine get outta the way, I have customers to serve.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
不要？
好吧，让开点，我还要招待其他顾客呢。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Wow.
You ordered too much.
If you eat over 5 you might need to fight with a monster in your stomach. Calm down buddy.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
哇。
你订得太多了。
如果你吃超过5个，可能得和你肚子里的魔物打一架。冷静点，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Dood~! You don't have enough money.
It's only ^3355FF100 Zeny^000000~ Seriously!
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
老兄~！你的钱不够。
只要^3355FF100泽尼^000000~ 说真的！

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
You seem to have too much stuff.
Lighten your pack before buying this.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
你似乎携带的东西太多了。
在买这个之前，先减轻一下你的负重吧。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
'Ice cream is...
Wait, don't you know
what Ice Cream is?
What rock have you
been living under?
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
“冰淇淋是……
等等，你不知道
什么是冰淇淋吗？
你是住在什么
岩石底下吗？

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
I'm not going to even start with how weird that sounds.
Anyway, get 'yer Ice Cream right here while it's nice and cold.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
我甚至不想开始解释这话听起来有多奇怪。
总之，趁现在冰凉可口，快来这里买冰淇淋吧。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Don't miss your chance to eat the greatest Ice Cream in all the land~!
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
不要错过品尝全大陆最棒冰淇淋的机会~！
